description: This PHP class file defines the 'issueTrackerCommands' class, which manages issue tracker operations such as creating, editing, deleting, and checking connections within the TestLink project. It includes methods for initializing GUI components, handling user actions, and interacting with the issue tracker manager.

classes.name: issueTrackerCommands
classes.description: Handles issue tracker commands and user interface interactions in the TestLink project, providing methods to create, edit, delete, and verify connections to issue trackers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database connection and issue tracker manager.

methods.name: getGuiOpWhiteList
methods.description: Returns the whitelist of GUI operations.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes GUI object with common properties for different actions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares GUI object for creating a new issue tracker configuration.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new issue tracker configuration and updates the GUI feedback.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares GUI object for editing an existing issue tracker configuration.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing issue tracker configuration and updates the GUI.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of an issue tracker configuration and updates feedback.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks the connection to the specified issue tracker type and updates the GUI with connection status.
